title: Rav Achdevoi bar Rav Mattenah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Bava Batra 151a:11](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.151a.11) relates that the sister of Rav Tuvia bar Rav Matna wrote her property over to him in the morning, and in the evening wrote it over to Rav Achdevoi bar Rav Mattenah; he came before Rav Nachman. [Shabbat 60b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.60b.20) gives the teaching directly from Rav Matnei, or according to another report, from Rav Achdevoi bar [Rav, Dikdukei Soferim] Matna in Rav Matna’s name. Hyman reports this reading at Shabbat 24a in Dikdukei Soferim as well (compare [Shabbat 24a:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.24a.7)).[^2]

notes.text: The exact Dikdukei Soferim readings and the Shabbat 24a edition claim remain attributed to Hyman; the consulted Shabbat 60b passage supplies the alternative transmitter chain.

In the linked Bava Batra story, the two deeds are written in the morning and evening. The consulted English identifies Tovi as the one who comes before Rav Nachman. The linked Shabbat 24a base text has Rav Achadvoi cite Rav Matna in Rav’s name, without the patronymic. Hyman’s exact Dikdukei Soferim citation remains a separate report.
